.rs-stage { grid-area: stage; position: relative; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; background: var(--rs-bg); }

.rs-stage .webgl-fallback { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
/* The minimap is anchored to the stage column instead of the viewport, so it
   never lands on the filter column or the inspector; the classic layout's
   side-panel offset does not apply here. */
.rs-stage .minimap, .rs-stage .minimap--shifted { position: absolute; right: 18px; bottom: 18px; }
/* The classic layout floats the minimap at --z-floating (30), which here would
   outrank the top bar (--z-overlay) and so cover its open tool menu and the
   corpus switcher. Nothing in the stage column is a stacking context, so the
   minimap takes the top bar's layer minus one: above the canvas, below every
   bar dropdown, the narrow-screen filter drop-down (z 19) and the app-level
   panels (chat, compare, path, modals). */
.rs-stage .minimap { z-index: calc(var(--z-overlay) - 1); }
/* Compare is still a viewport-wide overlay: step left by however much it spills past the inspector. */
.rs-stage .minimap--compare-shifted { position: absolute; right: calc(max(0px, var(--compare-panel-width) - var(--rs-right)) + 18px); bottom: 18px; }
.rs-stage__banner { position: absolute; top: 16px; left: 16px; right: 16px; z-index: var(--z-panel); display: flex; justify-content: center; pointer-events: none; }
